text.tspan: EKS Worker Nodes: one Auto Scaling Group across 3 Availability Zones
each pod gets a VPC IP
each pod gets a VPC IP
each pod gets a VPC IP
Worker nodes sit in PRIVATE subnets and reach the internet only outbound, through their AZ's NAT gateway (dashed arrows).
EKS managed node group = one ASG spanning the 3 private subnets (e.g. min 3 · desired 3 · max 6), nodes spread evenly.
If one AZ fails, 2 of 3 nodes keep running and the ASG launches the replacement in a healthy AZ.
